slice: RPP-5kl selected four-element tail append to a consumed MLINESTYLE
scope: Extends the selected AC1027 open, uncut, unfilled MLINE projector to append four tail elements to a source-bound two-element MLINESTYLE already used by ordinary MLINE consumers. It recalculates all existing and appended group-41 values against the complete six-element target offset set and publishes group-73 count 6. This is selected output/geometry evidence, not native CAD semantic qualification or whole-document support.

references.use: Group 73 is the number of MLINESTYLE elements; group 74 gives the repeated parameter count per element at each vertex; group 41 carries those parameters; group 75/42 carry area-fill parameter counts and values. The first group-41 value is the distance along the miter vector to the element path intersection.
Group 49 carries each MLINESTYLE element offset; the selected projection is limited to style flag 2.

contract.admission: The original MLINESTYLE body, dictionary/provider graph and every ordinary MLINE consumer must be source-bound. The source style has exactly two elements and the target appends exactly four complete tail tuples, yielding six. Existing offsets remain unchanged; the four new tuples use validated ACI and existing ByLayer/Continuous linetype providers. Source and target style flags are 2 with equal start/end angles. Every consumer remains live, in its original scope and model-identical during preflight. The consumed route admits this exact 2-to-6 profile; other source counts and append cardinalities remain refused.
contract.geometry: Each selected MLINE is open, has at least two vertices, positive finite scale, justification 1 or 2, unit extrusion, source-consistent WCS positions/directions/miters, exactly two group-41 parameters per source element with zero second values, and no group-42 fill values. Every original first group-41 value is validated. All six target parameters are recalculated using the complete offset set; bottom-justification shift is derived from the new minimum offset -4.0. Each appended element receives a [miter-distance, 0] pair and an empty fill-parameter list. The output MLINE element count becomes six without mutating caller models.
contract.identityAndOutput: The MLINE retains its redundant group-2 name and group-340 style reference. Output proof checks six group-49 offsets and corresponding ACI/linetype values; each consumer has group-73 count 6, eighteen group-74 counts of 2, thirty-six group-41 values, eighteen zero group-75 counts, and no group 42. Fresh import verifies all six style elements and per-vertex arrays plus unchanged WCS positions/directions/miters, scale and extrusion for model-space and named-block consumers.
contract.failureAndRetry: An unsupported style flag refuses before publication and preserves destination/caller state; correcting it permits same-adapter retry. A target with seven elements refuses before publication as the adjacent count boundary. A late live-consumer parameter mutation after entity emission refuses before publication; restoring caller state permits same-adapter retry. Successful output is reopened for field and geometry readback.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. ASCII/binary source and output routes remain supported. All drawings are authored at runtime from scratch and removed after success; no DWG/DXF fixture was committed.
contract.limits: Evidence covers AC1027 ASCII and binary sources crossed with ASCII and binary output; a two-element source style with four appended tails; flags 2, equal angles, open/unfilled/uncut MLINEs, one model-space and one named-block consumer, three vertices, center and bottom justification, and two extrusion planes. It does not qualify other source counts, other appended cardinalities, composed edits, other MLINE schemas/carriers/versions, native CAD rendering, document closure or independent 3D semantics. No support claim is promoted.

controls.styleAndConsumerProfile: The generated two-element source has offsets [1.25, -0.75]. Exact appended tuples are (-1.25, ACI 4, ByLayer), (-2.0, ACI 5, Continuous), (-3.0, ACI 6, ByLayer), and (-4.0, ACI 7, Continuous), producing [1.25, -0.75, -1.25, -2.0, -3.0, -4.0]. The bottom-justification shift becomes +4.0 and is checked for all six element parameters. Model-space and named-block consumers exercise center/bottom justification, three vertices and distinct extrusion planes.
controls.failureAndRetry: Four source/output profiles and eight successful readbacks; two unsupported-flag refusals and two late-consumer mutation refusals preserve destination state; four same-adapter retries succeed after state correction. The adjacent 2-to-7 append refuses atomically in ASCII and binary outputs.
